what_happened: Scene: layout 9 (brown CoffeeMachine036 below), wide printed tea mug_8 on a navy upper shelf next to a cheese-grater distractor. Stage 0: the gripper approached the mug and the fingers closed at ~78-96 with the mug still a few cm beyond the fingertips (wrist 84-96: mug in front of, not between, the fingers); no contact. The fingers then stayed closed (0.001) until the end. 120-600 the arm hovered 10-25 cm in front of the mug with the closed gripper (wrist 200-500: mug and grater in view, the mug never touched); ~700 it dropped down and away, and 900-1200 it hovered again in front of the shelf. The mug never moved, and the machine was never approached.
causal_chain: premature close short of the mug (78) -> gripper never reopens -> ~1100 steps hovering in front of the mug with closed fingers -> mug never picked -> timeout
self_recovery: none: no reopening of the gripper, no second grasp attempt.

packet_facts: close_events: 78 on_nothing; gripper width 0.001 from 112 to 1200

uncertain_about: Why the close was premature (same pattern as s15 and s25, all with mug_8).
